t: You're looking at South Kentish Town, a disused Underground station in Kentish Town, on the High Barnet branch of the Northern line. It's closed now. The architect Leslie Green designed it. He is best known for the stations he built for the Underground in the early 1900s, with oxblood red glazed faïence blocks, pillars, and semi-circular first-floor windows. His interiors were patterned with tiles, in what's called the Modern Style.
